facts.fact_text: On 9 January 2002, the parliamentary group of the Christian Democratic People's Party (CDPP) held a gathering in the Square of the Great National Assembly, in front of Government headquarters.
The parliamentary group of the Christian Democratic People's Party (CDPP) also held gatherings on 11, 13, 15, 16 and 17 January 2002.
